evidence: Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and adds the `testsubmitpackage` RPC method in src/rpc/mempool.cpp.
rationale: Adds the `testsubmitpackage` RPC to enable callers to test-validate 1p1c packages without mutating mempool state. The PR description notes this fills a missing capability requested in #32160, serving as a wallet pre-flight check for CPFP fee-bumping packages and sibling eviction.
